CustomField.label: Annual Contract Value (GBP)
CustomField.description: Annualised quote net value in GBP. Multi-year quotes (subscription term above 12 months) are normalised to a per-annum figure. Basis for the GBP-equivalent USD 10,000 ACV threshold (GBP 7,500) in the Centellic Payment Term Extension Process (Aug 2026).
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c), SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c <= 12 ), Net_Amount_GBP__c, Net_Amount_GBP__c / ( SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c / 12 ) )
